up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL224 (5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2A). Return only rows where the standard relation is '=' and pChEMBL values are not null. For each row, provide the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql: WITH target_info AS (SELECT tid, target_type, tax_id FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL224') SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, ti.target_type, ti.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_info ti ON a.tid = ti.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
